description:
The Apps Services team builds the tools and systems that move code from commit to customer, shipping to billions of users worldwide. We improve efficiency at every stage of the pipeline by surfacing problems early and removing friction, so teams across Apps can ship faster and with more confidence.

Description
As a Software Development Engineer, you'll design and build the internal systems that Apps teams rely on every day, such as feature tracking, release coordination, and workflow management tools used to ship 26 applications and frameworks. You'll evolve these applications and build new ones as the organization's needs change. You'll work side by side with cross-functional partners to find the operational pain points that slow people down. Then you'll replace manual coordination with automation that cuts effort and release delays.

In your first year, success might look like automating major parts of the release cycle time, increasing adoption of a key tool, or creating an application to coordinate critical processes.

Responsibilities
Build and maintain full-stack tooling and internal applications that improve development and delivery efficiency across the Applications organization
Own features and applications from problem definition and technical design through implementation, deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement
Develop AI-powered and agentic capabilities, such as MCP-style integrations and multi-step workflow orchestration, that connect with engineering data and tools, and evaluate their reliability
Operate and monitor the systems you build, using logging and observability tooling in Kubernetes-based environments
Collaborate across teams, incorporate user feedback, and contribute reusable tools, patterns, and technical guidance
Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements, distill complex requests into actionable engineering solutions, and communicate progress clearly

Minimum qualifications
5+ years of software development experience in full-stack role
4+ years and a strong proficiency in application programming or web development experience using Python, JavaScript, or Swift
Prior experience and proficiency deploying applications to distributed cloud environments such as Kubernetes
Prior experience and hands-on proficiency using AI tools (skills, MCP-style integrations, and agents) in daily engineering work, including building automations or integrations with them
Strong communication and cross-team collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively with partner engineering organizations and explaining technical concepts in clear, business-focused terms
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or we may consider an equivalent industry experience

Preferred qualifications
Experience with observability and logging tooling in Kubernetes-based environments
Swift application development experience, including native or server-side Swift tools
Experience with cloud data warehouses, ETL/ELT tools, and data observability
Experience translating ambiguous stakeholder requests into well-defined workflows, engineering requirements, and measurable outcomes
Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline architecture and integrating quality gates into automated delivery workflows
Experience building internal developer tooling or platform engineering systems used at organizational
